title: As Quatro Cores
summary: Kairos presents the final four 2027 uniforms and publicly announces New Balance as its technical apparel partner.
keyEvents: The final Black, Blue, White, and Green 2027 uniforms are delivered and presented.
At 14:00 Kairos publicly announces the New Balance partnership with the campaign BUILT FOR WHAT COMES NEXT.
All main and Academy uniforms share the same quality standard.
Academy Green is a player joke, not the official name of Counter-Strike Academy.
